100% On-Device & Private

SignDrop Privacy Policy

Effective Date: October 23, 2026

Welcome to SignDrop: PDF Sign & Fill. We created SignDrop to provide a fast, private, and permanent document signing experience without recurring subscriptions. Legal contracts, leases, financial instruments, and NDAs contain your most sensitive personal information. That is why SignDrop is engineered with a strict 100% on-device, zero-telemetry architecture.

🔒 Zero-Cloud Guarantee: SignDrop does not collect, transmit, store, or monetize your documents, contracts, signatures, or personal data. All document rendering, signing, and vector flattening operations occur 100% locally on your Apple device.

1. Document & File Handling

When you import a PDF document or scan a paper page using the camera, all operations are isolated within your local iOS/iPadOS application sandbox:

  • Local Sandbox Only: Your documents are never uploaded to any remote server or third-party cloud.
  • Permanent Vector Flattening: When you export a signed document, signatures and stamps are rasterized and burned directly into the PDF’s base vector layer using Apple’s native UIGraphicsPDFRenderer. This ensures signatures cannot be extracted or manipulated.
  • Zero Document Access: Developer Parth Darji has no ability to view, access, or intercept your documents.

2. Handwritten Signatures & Stamps

Your digital signatures, initials, and custom stamps are created using Apple’s official PencilKit framework:

  • Signatures are saved exclusively on your local device storage.
  • We do not sync or upload your signature drawings to any remote database.
  • You can delete any saved signature from the Signatures Vault at any time.

3. Camera Access (Document Scanner)

SignDrop requests camera access solely to enable the built-in document scanner (powered by Apple’s native VisionKit). Scanned camera frames are processed on-device in real time to generate multi-page PDF documents. No camera data or video feeds are ever recorded or transmitted externally.

4. In-App Purchases (StoreKit 2)

SignDrop Pro is offered as a single one-time lifetime purchase. All transactions are securely processed by Apple via the official StoreKit 2 API. We never handle, store, or have access to your credit card numbers, billing addresses, or Apple ID credentials.

5. Zero Third-Party Trackers & Zero Ads

SignDrop contains zero third-party advertising SDKs, zero tracking pixels, and zero telemetry frameworks (no Google Firebase, no Meta SDK, no Mixpanel). We do not collect identifiers, device fingerprints, or usage analytics.

6. Contact & Inquiries
